card.name: Modifier words before a following noun
card.fires_on: Modifying words such as "Highly", "Important", "practically" or "worth" that come right after a number or section heading and lead into a noun or phrase. Also fires on plural forms of number words such as "billions" or "millions" after a figure.

modes.label: Section heading openers
modes.description: A modifier right after a section number in drug-label headings, such as "Highly" in a heading about protein-bound drugs.

modes.label: Degree adverbs
modes.example: race, pervades<< practically>> all interracial interactions, distorting – consciously

modes.label: Plural number words after a figure
modes.description: "billions" or "millions" used in the plural directly after a numeral.
modes.example: Out of a total of some 144 millions of Orthodox adherents, the Russian membership comprised about 110<< millions>>.

card.plain: It marks small modifier words that sit between a number and the noun they describe, such as "Highly" in a heading or "millions" after a figure.
